candidates.description: This feature vector activates on a mixed set of subword tokens from multiple languages, particularly Thai characters, French/German name fragments, and English prefixes.
This feature vector activates on frequent subwords and characters commonly found in Thai and German text.
This vector activates strongly on the Thai letter 'ว' and substrings containing it, as well as English words related to sex and trauma.
This feature vector represents common syllables, particles, and word fragments in the Thai language.
This feature vector activates on common Thai syllable prefixes, morphological roots, and word fragments, particularly those starting with consonant clusters involving 'บ' (ba) or 'ด' (da).
This feature vector activates on tokens ending with the Thai consonant letter ก (ko kai).
This feature vector represents the Thai consonant letter 'น' (no-nen) and various character combinations or subword tokens containing it.
This vector is related to tokens containing the Thai consonant 'ท' (tho thahan).
This vector represents the set of consonant characters in the Thai alphabet.
This vector represents Thai language subword tokens, tone marks, and common Thai linguistic morphemes.
